What is M3A Team?

M3A Team (Minsait Multi Agents Team) is an enterprise-grade, reusable multi-agent AI ecosystem designed for any Minsait project — new or existing, any stack, any domain.

It provides a team of 12 specialized AI agents, each with a distinct persona inspired by historical and intellectual figures. Agents collaborate on quality gates, enforce architectural decisions, and produce executive-grade documentation — all within VS Code using GitHub Copilot Agent mode.

No external services, no cloud subscriptions beyond Copilot. Install with one command, activate with /m3a-init, and your entire team gains a structured AI workforce governed by 13 immutable laws.

💻

Works Inside VS Code

No external tools or platforms. Agents run as Copilot agent modes directly in your editor.

🔗

Zero Cloud Dependencies

Everything lives in your repository under .github/ — fully version-controlled and reviewable via PR.

⚖️

13 Immutable Laws

Governance baked into every agent: knowledge-first, no silence in reviews, mandatory consensus, operational honesty.

        Available Commands

        Command Description

        Install M3A Team

        One command installs all 12 agents into any VS Code project with GitHub Copilot.

        ⚠️ Prerequisites — Required before installing

        Make sure you have all three before running the install script.

        💻 VS Code with GitHub Copilot extension ↗ 🔧 GitHub CLI (gh) — installed and authenticated ↗ 🤖 GitHub Copilot subscription (Chat + Agent mode) ↗
        1

        Run the install script

        Execute from your project root (where .git/ lives)

        $tag=$(gh api repos/ealmeidaf_indra/m3a-team/releases/latest --jq '.tag_name'); $t="$env:TEMP\m3a-$(Get-Random)"; gh repo clone ealmeidaf_indra/m3a-team $t -- --depth 1 -b $tag -q -c advice.detachedHead=false; if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){ & "$t\scripts\install.ps1" -Mode project }else{ Write-Host "[ERR] Clone failed. Run 'gh auth login' and retry." -ForegroundColor Red }; if(Test-Path $t){ Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $t }
        tag=$(gh api repos/ealmeidaf_indra/m3a-team/releases/latest --jq '.tag_name') && t=$(mktemp -d) && gh repo clone ealmeidaf_indra/m3a-team "$t" -- --depth 1 -b "$tag" -q -c advice.detachedHead=false && bash "$t/scripts/install.sh" --mode=project && rm -rf "$t"
        2
        ⚡ Mandatory — Run First

        Activate with /m3a-init

        Personalizes config and activates all 12 agents for your project

        /m3a-init
        Required before any other command. /m3a-init configures agents with your project's stack, team, and context. Without it, agents operate without project knowledge.
        3

        Initialize knowledge base

        Recommended for existing projects — runs a deep codebase scan

        /m3a-init-knowledge
        4

        Start using commands

        All /m3a-* commands are now available in Copilot Chat

        /m3a-init-knowledge /m3a-assessment /m3a-story-done STORY-001
